title: RTFM JSON Schema Mapping (rtfm-mapping-v1)
description: Declarative mapping consumed by the RTFM open retrieval layer. Drop a file conforming to this schema in .rtfm/mappings/ and any JSON document matching match.schema_url or match.discriminator is extracted into typed chunks at sync time. Full reference: https://roomi-fields.github.io/rtfm/json-mappings/

$schema.description: Optional self-reference. Set to https://schemas.roomi-fields.com/rtfm-mapping-v1.json to enable IDE validation and autocomplete.

name.description: Stable identifier for this mapping. Used for deduplication on registration — two mappings with the same name replace each other (most-recently-loaded wins). Conventionally kebab-case with a version suffix, e.g. nblm-answer-v1.

match.description: Rules used to detect that a JSON document should be processed by this mapping. A mapping matches when ANY declared rule matches.

schema_url.description: Match if the document's $schema or $id field equals this URL. Preferred when the producing project publishes a formal JSON Schema.

discriminator.description: Match if every entry { field_path: expected_value } resolves to the expected value in the document. Field paths use dotted notation (a.b.c) and walk into nested dicts and list indices.

additionalProperties.description: Expected value (any JSON scalar — string, number, boolean, null).

chunks.description: Ordered list of chunk specifications. Each spec emits zero or more chunks at sync time. Required: at least one spec.

edges.description: Optional edge specifications. Each spec emits zero or more EdgeCandidates with the declared relation_type. Edge resolution to the database depends on the existing sync layer (import/link/include resolve to indexed files; custom relations like cites are produced but currently not materialized).

title.description: Template for the chunk's chapter_title. Supports {{ dotted.path }} placeholders evaluated against the current context (root document, or each item if foreach is set).

content.description: Template for the chunk content. Required and non-empty after rendering — empty content is silently skipped. Supports {{ dotted.path }} placeholders.

foreach.description: Dotted path resolving to a list. When set, one chunk is emitted per item, and templates inside this spec evaluate against each item.

metadata.description: Key-value pairs stored in chunks.metadata (JSON column). String values are template-rendered; non-string values pass through unchanged.

relation.description: Stored as relation_type in the edges table. Standard values: import, link, include (resolved by sync layer). Custom values are produced as EdgeCandidates but not yet materialized.

foreach.description: Like chunk-spec foreach: walks a list, emits one edge per item.

target.description: Template for the edge target reference. Supports {{ dotted.path }} placeholders. Resolution semantics depend on relation type.

target_kind.description: Informational hint about the kind of reference produced by target. Stored in EdgeCandidate.source_detail; future versions of the resolver may use it for resolution heuristics.
